decisions.reason: The fourth rotary axis accessory builds directly on the firm's machining know-how and complements its milling machines, so the firm can readily interpret customer feedback and refine it through its own R&D.

Hybrid additive post-processing is distant from the firm's existing knowledge, which limits its absorptive capacity, but it fits the stated direction toward digital workflows and materials processing, and the firm's strong in-house R&D can build the missing knowledge, so a cautious keep is justified.

The high-speed CNC milling line sits at the core of the firm's established expertise, was presented on its own page, and offers several models that the firm can assimilate learning into and improve continuously.
The automatic tool change system builds on the firm's established equipment and application know-how, so early results are easy to learn from and the product strengthens the core machine offer.
